purpose: Replace repetitive client-by-client manual QA with automated certification of an assembled tenant candidate against the manifest acceptance contract and previously certified capability contracts.
principle: EA certifies the platform capabilities and automatically validates each provisioning event; humans do not manually retest certified functionality for every client.

releaseDecision.CERTIFIED: all required layers pass with runtime evidence
releaseDecision.DENIED: any required layer fails or lacks required runtime evidence
releaseDecision.CONTRACT_ONLY: static/contracts pass but real runtime execution was not demonstrated

bankAccountStandard.goal: Provision another client from certified components without manually retesting the platform
bankAccountStandard.regressionStrategy: test capability versions centrally, then pin certified versions in client manifests

handoff.onDenied: return failing capability or binding to factory repair queue
handoff.onContractOnly: do not describe assembly line as bank-account-level production ready
